name: Belmond Grand Hotel Timeo
positioning: Historic hotel in Taormina, officially Grand Hotel Timeo, A Belmond Hotel, next to the Greek Theatre
best_for: Travelers who want a historic base beside Taormina's Greek Theatre
Guests who want fine dining, a spa and beach club access

facts.text: The hotel's story began in 1850 as a guesthouse for artists and painters drawn to Taormina by its views.
Ristorante Timeo serves seasonal Sicilian cuisine.
Bar Clementina serves cocktails inside Villa Timeo.
The hotel has a heated outdoor pool.
There is an infinity pool at Villa Timeo.
A complimentary shuttle runs to Lido Villeggiatura at Villa Sant'Andrea.
The hotel is a 1-hour drive from Catania Airport.
Families can ask about the Children's Welcome Kit and babysitting services.
The spa has three single treatment rooms and one couples treatment room, plus a hair salon.

highlights.text: Otto Geleng, the hotel's restaurant, was awarded a star by the Michelin Guide in 2026.
The hotel is located next to Taormina's Greek Theatre.
German artist Otto Geleng stayed at the hotel to witness the Greek Theatre, and his paintings from the terrace captured the world's imagination.
Guests have access to the Lido Villeggiatura beach club at Villa Sant'Andrea.

considerations.text: The hotel is a 1-hour drive from Catania Airport, so plan for a transfer.
